messages.subject: Project Redwood — EXCHANGED
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom, Howard,

We exchanged contracts this afternoon. Deposit of £2,175,000 paid to Pemberton Rowe as stakeholder. Completion fixed for 15 May. The £100,000 review retention will be held by us on completion pending the Mercer Wells review (longstop 30 Sep).

We'll circulate the completion statement and arrange the balance of funds nearer the time. SDLT of £1,077,000 will be payable within 14 days of completion.

Congratulations.

James

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
DX 134777 Bishopsgate | +44 (0)20 7946 0500
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
